english.title: Employ adult subject to control who had not been granted leave to enter / remain in UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) employed **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON EMPLOYED..) knowing that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was an adult subject to immigration control and
(C)_[had not been granted leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom]_
(D)_[whose leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom was invalid]_
(E)_[whose leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom had ceased to have effect ]_
(F)_[whose leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom was subject to a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..), which prevented the acceptance of that employment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21 of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
employed a person knowing that he/she was an adult subject to immigration control and that they had not been granted leave to enter/remain in the UK OR
whose leave to enter/remain in the UK was invalid OR
whose leave to enter/remain in the UK had ceased to have effect OR
whose leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom
was subject to a condition which prevented the acceptance of that employment

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Section 21(3) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that this offence shall be treated as:-
(a) a relevant offence for the purpose of sections 28B and 28D of the Immigration Act 1971 (search, entry and arrest), and (b) an offence under Part III of that Act (criminal proceedings) for the purposes of sections 28E, 28G and 28H (search after arrest).

This offence document is OBSOLETE from 12th July 2016 - H12771 (CJS Code IA06009) should be used after this date.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.Note:
In relation to a conviction occurring before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 12 months shall be taken as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit on prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
